caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing man with a dark mustache, wearing a large turban that is colored blue and yellow. He has a red robe with beige or tan trim draped over his shoulders, a light blue shirt underneath, and a striped yellow or gold sash tied at his waist. His pants are loose and reddish-brown, and he wears brown shoes. The man has one hand resting on his chest and the other hanging by his side. The statue stands atop a rectangular pedestal that is gray with black trim at the base. On the front of the pedestal are the words "A. OGDEN & CO" painted in gold, with two small gold decorative flourishes below the text. The background is a plain beige or off-white color.
title: Cigar Store Figure
